dhabi said allah and his apostle know best now this is a very significant statement and there is much that we can take from the from these words because this event occurred after um the revelation of time and this could be the significance behind this whole matter this whole um this whole report you see you had the mushrikeen from arabia of course not all of them i'm speaking about specific tribes they would literally prostrate towards the sun and at that specific time the prophet is saying oh by the way it's the sun that's prostrating to allah and it's the son that is subservient to allah and recognizes allah as the soul creator and the son is just a creation of allah so that's the significance of the timing of the when right as for the nature of this prostration we don't know we don't of course naturally um the sun doesn't have arms and legs and head or anything like that um and of course there are verses in the quran that speak about the source prostrating about trees prostrating we do not know how that occurs we do not know what that specifically entails we just know that the creation of allah prostrates to allah and in a way that we are not aware of all right of course the companions didn't understand the prostration of trees to be a physical action that they would observe and similarly the prostration of the sun isn't in a way that they could physically observe all it is as if being ordered it as if being ordered to return once it came then it will rise from the west this statement in arabic says it is as if it is being said to return from where you came so this is referring to the end of times in the end of times the sun is going to return meaning it will be coming from the west we will witness the sun coming from the west so there are two ways of understanding this um we could understand this to literally mean the sun itself is going to literally be going around the earth and coming from the west and rising from the west due to the motion of the sun that's one understanding the other understanding is that the earth will actually turn clockwise instead of counterclockwise and that will cause us to view the sun as if it is coming from the west the narrations also um through different paths but also through ibrahim bin yasid you also have them add that this occurs where it occurs under the throne now the question is are we supposed to under the throne to prostrate that conflicts with verses it conflicts with the hadith the throne of allah is above the heavens and the earth all right it's not under the heavens or the earth and due to that the concept of the sun going under the earth in order to get under the throne conflicts with islam when abraham said i am going to my lord he will guide me he did not mean it literally similarly the son going to the throne or going to allah doesn't need to be taken literally either so to answer the question of when does the sun prostrate towards allah well that is when the polytheists are prostrating towards the sun that's the significance of that statement as for where is the sun when it's prostrating well the sun is where it is um every single day it's moving in its own orbit it's not prostrating while under the earth because the throne isn't under the earth as established in many verses in the quran and in hadith as for the question of how is it prostrating we don't know how it prostrates we don't know how trees prostrate we don't know how sons prostrate is we just know that allah states that these entities prostrate and that's it and as for the sun going and coming back as i've stated before this is our perception and the report itself says it is as if it was said to the sun go back but let's for the sake of the argument say that this report has nothing to do with perception and that this report should be taken literally would that be a problem i'm sure many of you have heard critics of islam ask the question where does the sun go at night now the reason why this question is so often asked is because of this specific wording of the hadith in which reports the hadith while saying do you know where the sun sets so it is from this statement that they asked where does the sun set at night now there is a reason to assume that the word sets was not uttered by his teacher illamesh as you can see here in this other report by abu alia there is nothing about the sun setting instead it simply asks where does the sun go now is this unscientific is the sun stationary because according to modern science the sun is literally moving and this is in line with hadith now does the hadith say that this is going to occur every night no um so what exactly is the problem well the sun is moving in its orbit and is heading in the direction of the throne it's as simple as that now one may ask why should we trust over abu naam well it's simply because abu mawyah is the closest student of alamesh in fact himself says that omari was a student filament for 20 years abunda on the other hand was not a close student of la amish at all furthermore other students of al-amish narrate this hadith without saying the words sun sets including sufyana theory now this is also the wording of muhammad been obeyed in muslim another student of la mesh that's all i have for you guys today inshaallah if you found this beneficial assalamu alaikum
